operational-example.copy: Use Date Range Picker to capture one bounded start and end date range with readable value, local presets, and calendar selection. ZIP reference: DateRangePicker plus combo-range header composition.

scenario.title: Reporting window
scenario.meta: Start date, end date, and local presets

items.label: Invalid range
items.helper: End date must be after start date.

rationale: The ZIP includes a dedicated DateRangePicker and a combo-range demo. Flow keeps the field as the component and documents combo-range as composition.
It owns only local start/end selection, presets, selected range display, and calendar state.
Dashboard filters, comparison windows, URL persistence, and data refresh remain pattern responsibilities.

items.rule: Names the range purpose in visible text.
Shows the selected start and end dates as text.
Offers local shortcuts without owning reporting sync.
Shows month navigation and day targets.
Distinguishes start, in-range, and end dates.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, error, warning, selected, focus, hover, default
items: Associate the label and selected range with the trigger.
Expose the panel as a dialog with grid day semantics.
Keep start and end values visible as text.
Support keyboard opening, day selection, month navigation, and Escape close.
Do not use the component to own dashboard refresh or URL persistence.
